title: HydrogelFinder: A Foundation Model for Efficient Self-Assembling Peptide Discovery Guided by Non-Peptidal Small Molecules
summary: HydrogelFinder used a generative model and learned prediction to prioritize 111 candidate peptides; 17 were synthesized and nine self-assembled under tested conditions. Cell assays covered two selected materials and do not establish general safety or clinical suitability.
ai_technology: HydrogelFinder generative language model and learned gelation prediction
organization: Hunan University; Zhejiang University; King Abdullah University of Science and Technology; Central South University; Shandong University

evidence.tested: Primary abstract reports 111 candidates, 17 synthesized and nine experimentally self-assembling; cell compatibility tests were limited to two selected materials.
evidence.unknown: Independent replication and exhaustive prior-art review are not established.
evidence.ai_role: HydrogelFinder generative language model and learned gelation prediction

source_review.scope: Primary source checked for study identity, AI operation, dates, affiliations and the bounded result.
